title: GPU monitoring
subtitle: Authenticated GPU observations, findings, Agent delivery, and verified recovery evidence.
readonlyTitle: Observation does not grant action authority.
readonlyBody: GPU findings stay in shadow mode until a registered ActionType passes approval and safety checks.
unavailable: No authenticated GPU observation has reached the live stream. Confirm the collector, EventBus publication, and source freshness.

inventory.title: GPU inventory
inventory.description: Select one exact source and GPU identity. Different sources are never merged.
inventory.label: Observed GPU identities

charts.loadDescription: Measured utilization and framebuffer occupancy for the selected GPU.
charts.temperatureDescription: Measured GPU temperature in degrees Celsius.

metrics.title: Latest measured state
metrics.description: Missing counters stay unavailable; they are never treated as zero.

findings.title: Findings and follow-up
findings.description: A cleared condition is not proof that an unexecuted action caused recovery.
findings.none: No GPU finding is retained for this identity.

pipeline.title: Agent and delivery path
pipeline.description: Typed ownership is shown separately from notification delivery.

action.title: Governed response evidence
action.description: The Console renders receipts only. It cannot execute or approve the action.
action.none: No governed GPU response receipt is retained.

technical.title: Technical provenance
technical.sampleBoundary: Sample mode reproduces the measured development evidence. It is not a connection to the retained VM.
